description: Source code for VirtualInput plugin handling various input events, including key, mouse, and touch events, with support for different platforms (Linux, Windows, macOS). It includes classes for managing input mappings, event dispatching, and platform-specific input device handling.

classes.name: InputEvent
classes.description: Helper class for creating string representations of input events (key, mouse, touch).

classes.name: LinuxKeyboardInput
classes.description: Platform-specific implementation for Linux keyboard input device handling via uinput.

classes.name: IPCUserInput
classes.description: Implementation of VirtualInput that communicates over IPC, managing input channels and relaying input events.

methods.name: KeyMap::Import
methods.description: Imports key mappings from a JSON array, updating internal key map and change list.

methods.name: KeyMap::Export
methods.description: Exports current key mappings to a JSON array.

methods.name: VirtualInput::VirtualInput
methods.description: Constructor initializing input handling state.

methods.name: VirtualInput::~VirtualInput
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources.

methods.name: VirtualInput::Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for input events, optionally for all inputs.

methods.name: VirtualInput::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for input events.

methods.name: VirtualInput::AxisEvent
methods.description: Handles axis (scroll) input events.

methods.name: VirtualInput::PointerMotionEvent
methods.description: Handles pointer motion events.

methods.name: VirtualInput::PointerButtonEvent
methods.description: Handles pointer button press/release events.

methods.name: VirtualInput::TouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input events.

methods.name: VirtualInput::KeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key press/release events, mapping codes and managing modifiers.

methods.name: VirtualInput::RepeatKey
methods.description: Handles key repeat events.

methods.name: VirtualInput::SendModifier
methods.description: Manages modifier key state counts and triggers.

methods.name: VirtualInput::ModifierKey
methods.description: Sends modifier key events based on current modifier state.

methods.name: VirtualInput::DispatchRegisteredKey
methods.description: Dispatches key events to registered notifiers and manages repeat logic.

methods.name: LinuxKeyboardInput::LinuxKeyboardInput
methods.description: Constructor setting up Linux uinput device.

methods.name: LinuxKeyboardInput::~LinuxKeyboardInput
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up device resources.

methods.name: LinuxKeyboardInput::Open
methods.description: Opens the uinput device for sending input events.

methods.name: LinuxKeyboardInput::Close
methods.description: Closes the uinput device.

methods.name: LinuxKeyboardInput::Send
methods.description: Sends key, mouse, or touch events to the device.

methods.name: LinuxKeyboardInput::Updated
methods.description: Updates device key mappings based on change iterator.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::IPCUserInput
methods.description: Constructor initializing IPC-based input channel.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::~IPCUserInput
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::Consumers
methods.description: Returns list of current input consumers.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::Consumer
methods.description: Checks if a consumer is active.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::Consumer
methods.description: Enables or disables a consumer.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::Open
methods.description: Opens the IPC input channel.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::Close
methods.description: Closes the IPC input channel.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::Send
methods.description: Sends key, mouse, or touch input over IPC.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::MapChanges
methods.description: Applies key mapping changes.

methods.name: IPCUserInput::LookupChanges
methods.description: Reloads input mappings for a specific link.
